title: Deep learning on endoscopic ultrasound images assists pancreatic cancer diagnosis
summary: A deep-learning radiomics model trained on retrospective EUS images (368 patients) was tested on a prospective cohort of 123 patients, with AUC 0.936 (95% CI 0.889-0.976). In a reader study of seven endosonographers, assistance improved overall performance: one gained significant specificity (p = .035) and another significant sensitivity (p = .038). Junior endosonographers with assistance matched or exceeded seniors without it.
